what: Rec 2, Hopf bridge: the single-cell periodic orbit is certified from the end of the G_Ks branch (branch.py) to the supercritical Hopf point g_H of Theorem A (Erhardt's numerical value lies about 1.5e-8 above it) by a blown-up radii polynomial in the amplitude eps (fourier/hopf.py, LEMMAS-hopf.md)
not_claimed: No outside review has taken place. Stability is NOT proved uniformly on the bridge: only (a) for small amplitude, qualitatively (cited Hopf theorem, no explicit range), and (b) at the G_Ks values listed under stability_points (Stage S point proofs identified with the bridge by Lemma D). Monotonicity of g*(eps) in eps is not certified.
theorem_A: Theorem A (LEMMAS-hopf.md): in W = [0.02789, 0.02792], on every interval of the recorded cover, the equilibrium in the interval's polydisc has a simple pair lambda, conj lambda and 16 eigenvalues with real part <= others_max_re_upper < 0; Re lambda > 0 left of G_H and < 0 right of it; on G_H (width 2e-13) d Re lambda/dg < 0 and there is exactly one g_H with Re lambda(g_H) = 0; at g_H, l1 < 0 (enclosure in the record).

erhardt.note: Erhardt's MATCONT value; MATCONT's first Lyapunov coefficient equals omega times Kuznetsov's l1 in the normalisation <q, q> = 1 (physical units)

theorem_B: For every eps in [0, 6427/50000] the blown-up problem F(.; eps) = 0 (LEMMAS-hopf.md, B0) has a zero x*(eps) = (omega*, g*, c*, w*), unique in the ball B_r_hi(xbar(eps)) of the piece containing eps, real, continuous in eps. For eps > 0, z(t) = c*(eps) + eps w*(eps)(omega*(eps) t) is a periodic orbit of the single cell at G_Ks = g*(eps), of minimal period 2 pi / omega*(eps), whose first V Fourier coefficient (scaled variables, phase with Im a_1V = 0) is eps/2; distinct eps give distinct orbits. x*(0) is the Hopf point of Theorem A (g*(0) = g_H). By continuity, every G_Ks in [0.027778323912267213758, g_H) is g*(eps) for some eps in (0, 6427/50000], so the cell has a periodic orbit on the bridge at every such G_Ks.
theorem_C: Theorem C (LEMMAS-hopf.md): the K = 32 point proof at G_Ks = 0.02778 (hopf log) is the bridge orbit at eps_s in ['0.12769007505990053945', '0.12769007505990053946'] (Lemma D) and the G_Ks-branch orbit of piece G53P6 (branch.point_on_branch, on the validated snapshot of the branch logs recorded under bridge_checks.gks_branch_snapshot). So the G_Ks branch on [0.027499735464, 0.02778] and the eps-branch on [0, eps_s] form one continuous curve of real periodic orbits of the single cell from the Stage E orbit at G_Ks = 0.0275 to the Hopf point (x_e(g_H), g_H) of Theorem A, and for every G_Ks in [0.027499735464, g_H) the cell has a periodic orbit on this curve (G_Ks branch up to 0.02778, intermediate value theorem for g* on [0, eps_s] above it).
